flare:0xffbc4b519396487193f00136c8dce6a6.name: SparkDEX V4 SparkDEX Staked FLR/Firelight stXRP

metadata.description: Firelight stXRP (stXRP) is a liquid staking receipt token issued by Firelight on Flare. Depositors lock FXRP, Flare's bridged representation of XRP, and receive stXRP, which accrues staking rewards over time and remains usable as collateral or liquidity elsewhere in DeFi. The token is issued through a TransparentUpgradeableProxy pointing to Firelight's FirelightVault contract.
